column1: # tools/e2e_known_flaky.tsv -- REQ-0222: THE one greppable registry of
# known-flaky e2e failure FAMILIES (failure modes, not specs). Consumed by
# tools/e2e_flaky_gate.sh: when EVERY failure in an e2e step matches a family
# here, the step is rerun ONCE via the box-locked runner; a second red -- or
# ANY unmatched failure -- aborts exactly as before (real-regression
#   spec-pattern   grep -E over the playwright failure block; "-" = any spec
#   error-pattern  grep -E over the same block (both must match)
#   provenance     dated evidence. An entry WITHOUT provenance is invalid.
# Never add a family to make a red green: entries describe ENVIRONMENTAL
# failure modes proven to pass on rerun, with the mechanism understood.
